WhatsApp previously allowed iPhone users to add a second account within the same app, and is now planning to expand support to up to three accounts. Here's the details.

WhatsApp will support up to three accounts

Last June, WhatsApp officially launched multi-account support on iPhone, allowing users to add a second account within the same app.

After several months of beta testing, the feature was finally rolled out, providing an alternative for users who didn't want to rely on WhatsApp Business to manage a second account.

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp appears to be exploring expanding this feature to let users switch between up to three accounts without having to log out.

WABetaInfo reports:

The report added that each account will maintain its own chat history, notifications, privacy settings, backups, and media.

WABetaInfo pointed out that while two accounts are sufficient for many users, this feature will be very useful for those who need to use different combinations of work and personal phone numbers simultaneously.

That said, the feature is still in development and has not yet been made available to beta testers, so it may be some time before it sees a wider rollout.
